lines_and_groups.kind: solid C through F-right and A_1 continuing down-right
solid A through O and A_1 continuing down-right
solid A through F-left to D

shared_frame: One common horizontal principal axis and one common vertical thin-lens line. All three rays share A and the inverted image tip A_1.

focal_plane.instruction: No focal plane is drawn; the two F labels denote opposite principal-axis foci.

intersection_relationships: A is above B and both lie on the same object vertical left of the lens.
B_1 is above A_1 and both lie on the same image vertical right of the lens.
C, O, D lie on the common lens vertical in that top-to-bottom order.
A-C is parallel to the principal axis; C-F-right-A_1 are collinear.
A-O-A_1 are collinear and the center ray is not bent at O.
A-F-left-D are collinear; D-A_1 is parallel to the principal axis.
The three outgoing constructions meet at the single point A_1.
F-left and F-right lie on the principal axis on opposite sides of O.
The image is real, inverted and larger than the object in the source orientation.
measurement_policy: Observed proportions are qualitative, not numerical physical measurements. No normalized coordinates or inferred distances have been used in this source inventory.
